content.title: The 2026 Masters: What to know about golf's major at Augusta National
content.text: March 17, 2026, 3:32 p.m. ETIt’d be wise to have a size 44 long green jacket on hand at The Masters, which starts April 9.That’s what fits Scottie Scheffler, and he enters the 90th edition of the tournament as the clear favorite to win.Scheffler, 29, has won a green jacket, awarded to the winner of The Masters, two of the past four years – 2022 and 2024. Last year, he was in contention again, finishing fourth.But overlooking Rory McIlroy would be like overlooking the azaleas, dogwoods and magnolias that make Augusta National a magical setting for golf’s first major of the calendar.McIlroy, the 36-year-old from Northern Ireland, collapsed to his knees and wept last year at The Masters. He'd just capped an emotional victory over Justin Rose in a one-hole playoff that gave McIlroy a career grand slam.Don’t forget McIlroy in 2022 finished runner-up to Scheffler, either.How to watch The MastersDates: April 9-12Where: Augusta National in Augusta, Ga.TV: CBS/Paramount/ESPN/Prime Video. The Masters will stream live on Prime Video from 1-3 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9 and Friday, April 10, followed by ESPN’s broadcast coverage on both days from 3-7:30 p.m. ET.CBS will air the Masters live from 2-7 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11 and Sunday, April 12, with Paramount streaming live both days from 12-2 p.m. ET, according to Golfweek.
